items.reason: New guests receive an empty name in packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts:83-89, and the updated attendees are fetched without ordering at lines 92-108, so the original booker is not guaranteed to remain first. packages/emails/templates/organizer-add-guests-email.ts:26-29 directly interpolates attendees[0].name, allowing a nameless guest to produce a blank booker name in the subject.
